Why Obagi

Science that goes deeper than the surface

Unlike high-street skincare, Obagi works at a cellular level, targeting the root causes of pigmentation, ageing, uneven skin tone and acne rather than simply masking them. Founded by board-certified dermatologist Dr Zein Obagi, the range uses prescription-strength ingredients including tretinoin and hydroquinone, delivering results that are visible, measurable and long-lasting.

A note on authenticity

Only available through licensed clinics

Obagi Medical is a prescription and clinic-only brand, not available through general retailers. If you come across Obagi products being sold online at lower prices, please be aware these are very likely to be counterfeit. Always purchase through an authorised clinic to ensure you are receiving the real product, correctly prescribed and safely dispensed.
